items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: Yeah he played on some of the records, great, great, great, great man. In fact we just did that remake for the “West Side Story” also, where it was just piano and flute.

ctx.x: Did Dave ever get in on the — did he play on —

Yeah he played on some of the records, great, great, great, great man. In fact we just did that remake for the “West Side Story” also, where it was just piano and flute. And we did “I Feel Pretty” but with a whole new twist to it, which eventually had an Afro-Cuban thing but in seven-four. So it’s [scats]. And we did it at Carnegie Hall, we did that.
